title: HITS-CLIP
scope: Assigned Illumina HITS-CLIP schematic interpreted in the original Licatalosi 2008 Nova2 implementation scope. The depicted T1 route and catalogue placement of immunoprecipitation are retained as secondary schematic evidence, with original-implementation applicability unresolved. The attached poster contributes only its CLIP / HITS-CLIP row. Chi 2009 is a variant comparator, not a second extracted target. PTB-specific protocols, protein-DNA ChIP, later modifications, other poster rows, and other listed CLIP adaptations are excluded. The graph ends at cDNA, without reconstructing unshown adapter/PCR/sequencing operations.

operations.label: UV crosslinking
operations.description: Irradiation converts a population of contacting RNA–protein complexes into covalently linked complexes. The drawing labels the action UV 254 nm.
operations.mechanism: UV irradiation induces covalent RNA–protein crosslinks in situ; this precedes protein purification in the original paper.
operations.information_effect: A physical crosslink preserves an RNA–protein contact during subsequent purification. The catalogue notes inefficient crosslinking requiring close contacts, so recovered molecules do not establish a complete census of biological interactions.

operations.label: RNase T1 digestion
operations.description: Trim RNA in the retained RNA–protein preparation, yielding shorter RNA fragments still associated with crosslinked protein. T1 is the literal enzyme label in both attached depictions; its applicability to the original Licatalosi implementation is unresolved.
operations.mechanism: The labelled nuclease digests RNA around the RNA–protein complex; the schematic retains the protein-associated RNA segment. No nucleotide cleavage specificity or terminal chemistry is specified.
operations.information_effect: The retained RNA fragment represents a restricted region around an RNA–protein contact, rather than an intact-transcript abundance measurement.

method_scopes.rationale: All listed operations describe the assigned HITS-CLIP schematic and its catalogue-explicated protein selection. Licatalosi 2008 verifies the Nova2 application and in-situ crosslinking before purification, but registered Methods Summary [b00037] delegates CLIP to an earlier paper and does not establish nuclease identity or the nuclease/immunoprecipitation order. The fixed T1-prepared input histories in this route therefore remain schematic-level boundaries, not verified original-protocol histories. Argonaute miRNA/mRNA fractions are unshown and are not added. The shared CLIP label does not assert interchangeability of complete implementations.
